a2-u9-l1#milovat.picture: In the dormitory corridor, Sarah kneels to hug Filip's dog, who wags his tail and licks her cheek; Filip watches, smiling shyly, and Emma laughs.

a2-u9-l2#lev.picture: At Bratislava's zoo on a wooded hillside, a big maned lion lies on a rock in its enclosure among the trees. Sarah, at the railing, stares at it wide-eyed; Liam and Emma stand beside her.

a2-u9-l2#tiger.picture: At the zoo, a tiger pads along the rocks of its enclosure between the trees; Liam points it out to Sarah.

a2-u9-l2#slon.picture: At the zoo, an elephant in its big paddock sprays water over its back with its trunk; Sarah, holding an ice cream, laughs at it from the fence.

a2-u9-l2#opica.picture: At the zoo, behind the glass of the monkey house, a monkey hangs from a branch by one arm and pulls a face at Sarah, who pulls one back, her nose almost touching the glass.

a2-u9-l2#zirafa.picture: At the zoo, a giraffe in its big paddock stretches its long neck up to eat leaves from the top of a tall tree; Liam, at the fence, looks up at it.

a2-u9-l2#medved.picture: At the zoo, a big brown bear stands up on its hind legs among the rocks and trees of its enclosure; Emma, Liam and Sarah watch from the path, impressed.

a2-u9-l4#cirkus.picture: Evening on a meadow at the edge of town: a circus big top, striped red and white, with flags on top and lights strung round the entrance. People queue to go in; Emma, Liam and Sarah walk towards it.

a2-u9-l4#choice-pozyvam-vas-do.picture: On a street in Bratislava, Sarah tugs Emma's sleeve and points at a big circus poster on a wall, showing a striped big top, an acrobat on a rope and a clown. Liam stands back with his arms folded, frowning; Emma smiles at them both.

a2-u9-l4#listky-su-vypredane.picture: At the circus box office by the big top, the woman behind the window spreads her hands apologetically: no tickets left. Emma, Liam and Sarah, at the front of the queue, look disappointed.

a2-u9-l5#artistka.picture: Inside the circus big top, under the spotlights, a woman performer in a sparkly costume dances on a rope stretched high above the round ring, arms out for balance; the tiered seats all around are full of people looking up.

a2-u9-l5#klaun.picture: In the circus ring, a clown with a red nose, a curly orange wig, baggy trousers and huge shoes juggles coloured balls; Sarah laughs in the front row.

a2-u9-l5#akrobat.picture: Three acrobats in matching costumes perform in the circus ring under the spotlights: two stand side by side and the third does a handstand on their shoulders.

a2-u9-l5#vzrusujuci.picture: In the tiered seats of the circus, Emma, Liam and Sarah lean forward on the edge of their seats, gasping, as a performer leaps between ropes high above the ring; Sarah grips Liam's arm.

a2-u9-l6#grammar-active-participles.picture: At the zoo, the lion lies fast asleep on its rock in the sun, eyes shut and chin on its paws; Sarah, at the railing, puts a finger to her lips to hush Liam.

a2-u9-l7#babka-a-vnuk.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Marek in the narrow kitchen of his flat, phone at his ear, a pen and notepad in his hand. Right: babka Helena at the home phone in the hallway of the Šimkos' house in Žilina, beaming in surprise at hearing from her grandson.

a2-u9-l7#kolac.picture: Babka Helena's strawberry cake on a baking tray on the kitchen table of the Šimkos' house in Žilina: a sponge base topped with strawberries and whipped cream, cut into squares. Babka Helena lifts out the first square with a cake slice.

a2-u9-l8#vajce.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek cracks an egg into a mixing bowl; a box of more eggs waits beside it on the counter.

a2-u9-l8#muka.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek tips a big paper bag of flour into a bowl, and a white cloud of flour puffs up into his face.

a2-u9-l8#jahoda.picture: At a fruit stall at the market, the stallholder weighs a heap of ripe red strawberries on the scales for Marek, who sneaks one to taste.

a2-u9-l10#piect-upiect.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek, in oven gloves, slides a baking tray of cake mixture into the hot oven.

a2-u9-l10#miesat-vymiesat.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek stirs a big bowl of thick, pale-yellow cake mixture with a wooden spoon.

a2-u9-l10#slahat-vyslahat.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek whisks eggs and sugar into a pale, fluffy foam in a big bowl, the whisk going fast and a few splashes on his red flannel shirt.

a2-u9-l11#krajat-pokrajat.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek slices strawberries in half with a small knife on a chopping board.

a2-u9-l11#zdobit-ozdobit.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek, tongue between his teeth in concentration, pipes swirls of whipped cream onto the strawberry cake on its baking tray.

a2-u9-l13#choice-stol-je-prestrety.picture: In Marek's flat, Lucia has laid the small table by the living-room window for two: a white cloth, two plates, wine glasses, candles and a vase of flowers. She steps back to admire it.

a2-u9-l15#nervozny.picture: In his flat, Marek, in a clean white shirt, paces by the laid table by the window, checking his watch and running a hand through his hair; Lucia, on the sofa, smiles and rolls her eyes.

a2-u9-l15#vyzeras-krasne.picture: Marek opens the front door of his flat to Veronika in her new dark-red dress, hair loose. He stares, open-mouthed and delighted; she smiles shyly.

a2-u9-l15#nebudem-vas-rusit.picture: In the hallway of Marek's flat, Lucia, coat on and bag over her shoulder, slips out of the front door, winking and waving at Marek and Veronika behind her.

a2-u9-l16#plnene-papriky.picture: In the narrow kitchen of Marek's flat, Marek lifts the lid off a pot of stuffed peppers: green peppers filled with meat and rice, simmering in red tomato sauce, steam rising.

a2-u9-l16#co-oslavujeme.picture: Evening at the candlelit table by the window in Marek's flat: Marek pours champagne into Veronika's glass. Veronika, in her dark-red dress, looks round at the candles and flowers, surprised and curious.

a2-u9-l17#na-prvy-pohlad.picture: A winter memory in the hospital treatment room: Veronika, in her white coat over blue scrubs, wraps Marek's broken arm in plaster. Marek, in his red flannel shirt, can't take his eyes off her, smitten.

a2-u9-l17#lubim-ta.picture: Later that evening at the candlelit table in Marek's flat, Marek and Veronika hold hands across the table and look into each other's eyes, both beaming.

a2-u9-l18#priatelka.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Marek comes in arm in arm with Veronika, both beaming; Lucia throws up her hands in delighted disbelief, and Emma laughs and claps.
